name: The Westin Resort & Spa Ubud, Bali
positioning: Wellness and family resort near Ubud overlooking Ubud Forest, with an infinity pool, private pool villas, Heavenly Spa and a riverside Wellness Pavilion
best_for: Wellness travelers who want yoga, spa treatments and forest views
Families wanting a kids club and two-bedroom family villas
Travelers who want to experience Balinese culture and dance

facts.text: Heavenly Spa offers treatments for couples or individuals.
The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio is open 24 hours.
Rooms, suites and villas are filled with natural light and have a Heavenly Bed and Heavenly Bath.
Two-bedroom family villas have garden views and a separate living area.
The Westin Family Kids Club offers experiences inspired by nature and Balinese culture.
The Kids Club has nature-inspired activities, interactive indoor spaces and supervised outdoor play areas.
An Explorer Expert guides guests through sacred temples, gardens and sustainable farming.
Tall Trees Restaurant is centered around a wood-burning oven, with alfresco dining overlooking the forest.
The Pool Bar sits beside the infinity pool with views of Ubud's jungle canopy.
Valet and motorcycle parking are complimentary.

highlights.text: Three decks off the open lobby and bar have views of Ubud Forest and the infinity pool.
Accommodation includes deluxe rooms and private pool villas.
A yoga pavilion overlooks the tropical Ubud forest.
Lifestyle programs are held at the resort's riverside Wellness Pavilion.
Guests can learn Balinese dance from local Balinese dance teachers.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes the hillside location means you need transportation to reach the Ubud town center.
